# Next Neon CI Template

> Dual-mode Next.js CI template: DEPLOY_TARGET=cloud (Neon + Vercel) or selfhosted (Postgres + Docker).

This file is low-cost AEO hygiene, not a proven ranking signal.

## Pages

- / : Product overview and pipeline demo entry
- /api/health : Liveness probe
- /api/items : Demo items list/create API
- /api/openapi : OpenAPI 3 document generated from drizzle-zod contracts

## Notes

- Selfhosted mode is plain Postgres, not Neon OSS.
- CI owns deploys; do not enable Vercel Git auto-deploy in cloud mode.
